dataset.original_source_attribution:
This is the Grunfeld (1950) Investment Data.

The source for the data was the original 11-firm data set from Grunfeld's Ph.D.
thesis recreated by Kleiber and Zeileis (2008) "The Grunfeld Data at 50".
The data can be found here.
http://statmath.wu-wien.ac.at/~zeileis/grunfeld/

For a note on the many versions of the Grunfeld data circulating see:
http://www.stanford.edu/~clint/bench/grunfeld.htm

design.identification_note: Numerical regression check only; instrument exclusion/exogeneity NOT justified.

se.reason: Statsmodels default IV2SLS uses homoskedastic covariance; Quasi currently reports HC0-like covariance. These are NOT comparable SEs.

limitations: Numerical parity is NOT inference validation or credible causal identification.
